question: Which products are in the Electronics category?
expected_sql: SELECT id, sku, name, price, stock_qty FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics';

question: How many orders are there for each status?
expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: What are the 5 most expensive products?
expected_sql: SELECT id, sku, name, price, category FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the total amount spent per customer?
expected_sql: SELECT u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: Which products have never been ordered?
expected_sql: SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.category FROM products p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.id IS NULL;

question: What is the total revenue per product category?
expected_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: Show all delivered orders paid by credit card with a total above $200
expected_sql: SELECT id, user_id, total_amount, shipping_city, shipping_country, created_at FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered' AND payment_method = 'credit_card' AND total_amount > 200 ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

question: Which customers have placed more than 3 orders, and what is their average order value?
expected_sql: SELECT u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM users u JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id GROUP BY u.id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.email HAVING COUNT(o.id) > 3 ORDER BY order_count DESC;

question: What are the top 10 best-selling products by total units sold?
expected_sql: SELECT p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.brand, p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold, SUM(oi.subtotal) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.sku, p.name, p.brand, p.category ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which brands have the highest average order value across all orders that include their products?
expected_sql: WITH brand_orders AS (SELECT p.brand, o.id AS order_id, o.total_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.brand, o.id, o.total_amount) SELECT brand, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders_containing_brand, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM brand_orders GROUP BY brand ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;
